corrections: The hyoid is a suspended U-shaped bone; it is not classified here as a sesamoid.
Sartorius supports hip movement and knee flexion. Quadriceps extend the knee.
Sacral parasympathetic neurons at S2-S4 are distinguished from thoracolumbar sympathetic lateral horns.
Coccygeal segment counts and vascular branching patterns vary.
limits: Gross source meshes and original schematic detail models are distinguished. Illustrations do not represent microscopy, validated segmentation, physiological simulation or a patient scan.
